fields.headline: FOURBALLS.
fields.body: Two against two, four balls in play, and only the best one on each side counts.

fields.headline: BEST NET SCORE COUNTS.
fields.body: Everyone plays their own ball. On each hole the better net score on each side is the side's score. Lower wins the hole.

fields.headline: 90 PER CENT.
fields.body: Each player gets 90% of their course handicap, then shots are given off the lowest in the match. That is the WHS figure, and the app defaults to it.

fields.headline: FOUR SCORES, ONE HOLE.
fields.body: Every player's gross goes on the card. The app works out whose ball counts, with each player's own shots on the stroke index, and shows it before the next tee.
